# Enable only after the dedicated staging bucket passes multipart SHA256,
# conditional completion, CORS and AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload lifecycle checks.
S3_MULTIPART_ENABLED=false
# Supervised durable cleanup process. Failure is a deployment failure, not silent data loss.
STORAGE_CLEANUP_WORKER_ENABLED=true
STORAGE_CLEANUP_POLL_MS=10000

recovery:
    name: PostgreSQL backup and migration recovery
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: maras_qa
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: synthetic-ci-only
          POSTGRES_DB: maras_qa
        ports: ["55439:5432"]
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U maras_qa"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Rehearse old and new backups on disposable databases
        env:
          QA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p .data
          node --input-type=module -e 'import{writeFileSync}from"node:fs";writeFileSync(".data/qa-database.json",JSON.stringify({url:"postgresql://maras_qa:synthetic-ci-only@127.0.0.1:55439/maras_qa"}),{mode:0o600});'
          node scripts/qa-backup-restore.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: database-recovery-evidence
          path: .data/qa-backup-restore-report.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
